card.name: Words before a span of years
card.fires_on: The word just before a length of time in years or decades, such as half, five, eight, first or a number. It is general web text about history, where a long period is being described.

modes.label: Quantity word before century or decades
modes.description: A word like half, five or eight comes right before century or decades.
modes.example: for nearly<< half>> a century his pastoral duties, his watch

modes.label: Start of a numeric year span
modes.description: The gap just before a number that gives a span of years or a date range.
modes.example: Throughout its<< >>71-year history, which ended in

modes.label: Possessive or lead-in before an age or date
modes.description: Words like its, over or introduction that lead into an age or a year.
modes.example: As City Hall neared<< its>> 100th birthday in

card.writes: It pushes up number words like sixty, seventy and eighty and suppresses the word years, so a tens number is expected next rather than the unit.
card.plain: It fires when the text is about to say how many years or decades something lasted, before the number or unit appears.
